name: Panoramacamping Westendorf
beschreibung: The Panoramacamping Westendorf is located in Brixental in Tirol, surrounded by the mountains of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents on a level, well-maintained grassy area with a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The facilities include sanitary facilities, electricity connections and a laundry room. Nearby are shopping facilities and dining establishments in the village of Westendorf. In winter, the ski area SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental with numerous pistes and lifts is reachable. In the summer months, hiking trails and mountain bike routes of varying difficulty levels are available. Guests find a quiet atmosphere at the campsite with direct access to the nature of the Tiroler Bergland.
